# Cncf Vultr Kubernetes Engine Reviewer

Review Vultr Kubernetes Engine using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Hosted category. Vultr Kubernetes Engine gives developers a simple way to deploy containerized workloads with predictable pricing on a fully-managed Kubernetes cluster that integrates with other Vultr managed services such as Load Balancers, Block Storage, and DNS.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
